ns2:course.label: Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Special topics in subject areas within the College of Fine and Applied Arts intended to augment the existing curriculum. 0 to 4 undergraduate hours. 0 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated for a maximum of 8 credit hours in separate terms if topics vary.
